concepts: A black-billed cuckoo has a distinctive long pointed beak
a distinct white bar across the primary feathers
Its beak appears to have some white or light-colored markings around its base.
a dark grey or blackish mask through the eye
a white trailing edge on the secondaries
a small, upturned tuft of golden-yellow feathers behind the eye in one image

a dark, metallic green or brown crown
a dark eye embedded in the yellow mask
a bird found in dense forest
a bird found in deciduous forest
a prominent white or light-coloured eyebrow stripe
a smooth unstreaked light gray throat and breast
uniform dark gray or brown upperparts
a bird that nests in tree cavities
a mostly black and white striped plumage pattern
a dark-bordered rufous or orange crown stripe
a bird with iridescent gorget feathers
a patch of blue skin at the base of the lower bill
dark wing feathers with greyish edges
plumage blending with the color and texture of wood or bark
chestnut colored streaks on the breast and sides

a wing bar formed by pale tips
